name: Labeled Sample Compression / Projected No-Clashing Teaching Dimension
details: The five-cube has LSC two but projected NCTD three. The fixed-block family excludes projected NCTD at most LSC plus a universal additive constant, and requires coefficient at least $5/4$ in any universal reverse affine bound. No unbounded-ratio separation is asserted.
proof_source: Full comparison argument in the LaTeX survey: cor:compression-nctd-gap. Endpoint value proofs are database-owned.
witness_verification: The five-cube endpoint values are two and three; both parameters have linear order on full cubes, so the witness is strict rather than an unbounded ratio.
references: \cite{KSZ2019}, Theorem 19 and Proposition 28(2), together with the cube projection identity and the database-owned full-cube compression proof.
